jobs.description: What will you be doing?As a forklift operator, you’ll play a key role in our warehouse. You’ll ensure that pallets of our beverages are delivered safely and to the right location. DescriptionIn this role, you collect, deliver, and exchange containers at different clients. You drive a modern hook lift truck to a range of locations, such as construction sites, businesses, and recycling facilities. The containers mainly hold construction and demolition waste, which you transport for recycling. You are independently responsible for your truck, your route, and the containers. You make sure everything is done safely and according to agreements. You work full-time, Monday through Friday, between 6:00 AM and 6:00 PM, averaging 40 hours per week. You keep in contact with clients, report any special circumstances to planning, check your vehicle, and keep up with administration and transport documents. About the clientThe company operates in the water and waste sector. You work with modern equipment and are part of an organization focused on recycling and waste collection. Requirements• You have a CE driver’s license and Code 95 • Experience driving a hook lift truck • Preferably experience in recycling, waste collection, or container transport • Living in Vlaardingen or nearby • Able to work independently and responsibly • Speak Dutch or English • Customer friendly and professional • Safety-minded • Willing to do physical work • Experience with hook lift combinations for different types of containers Our offer• Gross monthly salary between €2,800 and €3,600, depending on experience • Temporary travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer • Prospect of a permanent contract • 27.5 days off • 10-day practical training from day one • Training budget up to €2,500 for personal development • Good pension plan • Opportunities for advancement • Personal guidance • Pleasant work atmosphere with short lines of communication • Regular company activities, such as a summer BBQ and Christmas party
